claims.statement: Carroll, who kept a dramatic saloon near the Varieties, was understood to have been the go-between through whom Tom Allen and Mike McCoole arranged their match.

claims.statement: Tom Allen was due to fight Mike McCoole on 15 June 1869; a bettor offered $1,000 to $700 that McCoole would whip Allen in seven and a half minutes.
claims.excerpt: to seven hundred that McCoole would whip Allen in exactly seven minutes and a half.
